title: Engineering Lifecycle Project Settings
description: The one hand-authored, committed file under .project/.engineering/. Everything else in that tree is regenerable.

provider.description: A tracker in scripts/trackers.py, or one declared as a JSON overlay under tracker/providers/.

enforcement.description: How loudly unfiled issues are surfaced. 'ask' is a louder reminder, not a block: the only hook event that can force a decision is PreToolUse, and gating unrelated edits on an unfiled issue would be user-hostile.

mcp_server.description: The server segment of the MCP tool name. A workspace connector gets a UUID; a .mcp.json declaration gets its declared name. Written back by reconcile once one is known to work.

scope.description: Where issues are filed. Keys are provider-specific: team/project/cycle for Linear, owner/repo for GitHub. project_url is decoded into an id.

status_map.description: Local status -> the tracker's workflow state name.
